# Are your EBS volumes the wrong type?

> Paste your EBS volumes (type, size, provisioned and peak IOPS) and get the cheapest volume type that still covers the peak, the aws ec2 modify-volume command, gp2 burst risk and unattached volumes. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
